notes: Atari Corp.'s own 1986 instruction leaflet for the 2600 'Jr.' shell (©1986 Atari Corp., C026260-001), archive.org scan, OCR text layer; primary. The leaflet calls the product 'ATARI 2600'; 'Jr.' is the scan's title.

Partial facts not filed: 'Insert a game cartridge into the cartridge slot in the center of the console' (no orientation stated, so media stays uncovered); 'Set the CHANNEL SELECTOR on the back of the game console'; the 'TV TYPE' switch; the AC adaptor's round end into 'the power jack on the game console'; the fluted end of a detachable VIDEO CABLE into the console; the joystick into the 'Left Controller' port. The leaflet names no difficulty, select or reset controls and no connector types, so controls and ports are not complete lists.
No dimensions or mass found (no museum record of this shell read). external_ids are the platform's (Wikidata Q206261, igdb from its P5795).
